name: New Jatamansi Powder 100gm–For Skin & Hair Care
original_description:
### New Jatamansi Powder – 100gm | Traditional Ayurvedic Herb for Skin & Hair Care

Rooted in ancient Ayurvedic tradition, Jatamansi (Nardostachys jatamansi) is a revered herb known for its calming essence and gentle properties. Sourced from high-altitude regions and carefully dried and ground into a fine powder, this pure, unadulterated Jatamansi is traditionally used in herbal formulations for skin and hair care rituals.

In Ayurvedic practice, Jatamansi has long been valued for its aromatic qualities and its role in supporting natural balance. Many users incorporate it into face masks, hair pastes, and aromatherapy blends as part of daily self-care routines.

Why Choose Falcon Herbs Jatamansi Powder?
- 100% pure, organic Jatamansi root powder — no additives, fillers, or preservatives
- Hand-harvested and sun-dried to preserve natural integrity
- Traditionally used in herbal blends for skin and hair wellness
- Ideal for DIY Ayurvedic formulations — mix with rose water, aloe vera, or coconut oil

How to Use
Add 1–2 teaspoons to your favorite carrier oil, yogurt, or herbal paste for topical application. For internal use, consult a qualified Ayurvedic practitioner.

Store in a cool, dry place. Keep away from children.

Jatamansi is a traditional herb with a rich heritage in Ayurveda. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition.
